newsitem.title: USA: Lewis Galoob files for 2.4 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Lewis Galoob files for 2.4 mln common shrs.

text.p: Lewis Galoob Toys Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.4 million common shares.
Of the total, the company said it would sell 2.0 million shares while certain shareholders would offer 392,866 shares.
It said net proceeds will be used to prepay short-term debt, repay mortgage on its headquarters and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made by an underwriting group led by Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co LLC. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 358,930 additional shares.
